faqs.q: Can I get a BOBCARD Easy Credit Card even if I do not pay taxes?
faqs.a: Yes, you can get this card even if you do not fall in a tax bracket that requires tax payment. However, you must meet the eligibility criteria set by the bank in order to avail this card.

faqs.q: Is BOBCARD Easy Credit Card available on both Visa and RuPay platforms?
faqs.a: Yes, BOBCARD Easy Credit Card is available on Visa, Mastercard and RuPay platforms, giving cardholders the flexibility to choose as per their preference and acceptance.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for BOBCARD Easy Credit Card?
faqs.a: Salaried or self-employed Indian residents aged between 21 and 60 years for salaried and 24 and 65 years for self-employed applicants with a stable income and good credit history are eligible to apply for BOBCARD Easy Credit Card. The minimum income requirement details are mentioned on the page above.

faqs.q: What are the charges for international transactions on BOBCARD Easy Credit Card?
faqs.a: A foreign currency markup fee of 3.5% of the transaction value is applicable on all international spends made with BOBCARD Easy.

faqs.q: How do I increase my BOBCARD Easy Credit Card limit?
faqs.a: To increase your credit limit, you can place a request with the bank by providing income proof or maintaining a strong repayment history, as the bank reviews your eligibility before approving a higher limit.
